scoring_policy.description: Correct measured stages: 20 correctness + up to 50 benefit + 20 worst-case + 10 consistency points. Incorrect stages: 0–19 points. Missing evidence: unscored.
scoring_policy.key_stages: Every verified stage scoring strictly above the user threshold; no top-N limit. Failed or incomplete stages go to review. Final code is comparison only.

definitions.execution_time_reduction_percent: 100 * (1 - candidate_time / baseline_time); negative means longer execution
definitions.aggregate_speed: Median of per-workload median speedup ratios; not total elapsed time
definitions.correctness_change_variance: Population variance of candidate minus original numeric outputs; excluded non-numeric/exception cases remain covered by pass/fail checks
definitions.speed_change_variance_pp_squared: Population variance of percentage speed increases across workloads, in percentage-points squared; workload sensitivity, not timing noise or a confidence interval
definitions.worst_observed_speed: Lowest percentage speed increase across workloads; may still be positive when every workload improves
definitions.slowest_observed_workload: Largest candidate median execution time across workloads, distinct from worst relative speed change
definitions.pass_population_variance: Population variance of case outcomes (pass=1, fail=0), p*(1-p); not a correctness guarantee
definitions.numeric_error: Candidate minus baseline scalar return value; exceptions and non-finite/non-numeric outputs excluded
definitions.timing_variance: Population variance of per-call batch timing samples; UI units are microseconds squared
definitions.p05_p95: Interpolated empirical timing percentiles, not confidence bounds
definitions.missing_values: null means not measured or not applicable; do not plot missing values as zero
definitions.correctness_groups: Candidate-specific suites differ; use the shared source group for like-for-like comparisons
definitions.duplicate_code: identical_to marks byte-identical code; measured speed differences between those files are noise
definitions.coverage: Case counts include repeated inputs across coverage sources; passing finite tests does not prove equivalence
